title: Single-lane streets in Washington and Portland
summary: On Q Street in Washington, DC, the game drew a center divider through a single travel lane and omitted the white side markings. Two separately flown aerial surveys and the city cross section register four short observed paint spans. Southwest Harvey Milk Street in Portland tests the single-lane rule in another state.
measurement: The false divider disappeared in both native views. The Portland Miata kept four tire contacts for 657 ticks along 45 m. A separate first-visit test applied seven registered map spans while the car retained its original tile, ground material and colliders.
